site.title: Site
site.description: Free Open-Meteo API for private noncommercial use. Existing inverters and strings are shown sequentially when editing.

inverter.title: Inverter

data.power_entity_id: PV power at the AC inverter output (optional)
data.energy_entity_id: Cumulative PV yield at the AC inverter output (optional)
data.measurement_valid_entity_id: Measurement source valid (optional: only on permits measurements)

inverter.description: AC inverter output. Switching to DC clears prior sensor bindings; choose the DC meters in the next form. Optional validity input: only on permits new original measurement reports; off, unknown, unavailable or missing blocks measurements. This is separate from curtailment. New reports are required after recovery; available-potential forecasts remain.

data.wind_speed_factor: Wind factor to coefficient reference height

dc_inverter.title: DC solar charge controller
dc_inverter.description: Measurement boundary: DC output of the MPPT solar charge controller. Power and yield meters must measure this PV output, excluding battery current from other sources. DC losses are additional to string losses. Connected strings share one controller limit. Optional validity input: only on permits new original measurement reports; off, unknown, unavailable or missing blocks measurements. This is separate from curtailment. New reports are required after recovery; available-potential forecasts remain.

data.power_entity_id: PV power after the DC charge controller (optional)
data.energy_entity_id: Cumulative PV yield at the DC controller output (optional)
data.measurement_valid_entity_id: Measurement source valid (optional: only on permits measurements)

error.invalid_timezone: Invalid time zone or empty model list.
error.invalid_inverter: Invalid output stage, identifier or sensor binding. Each power/yield meter belongs to exactly one output stage.
error.at_least_one_inverter: At least one output stage is required.
error.invalid_string: Invalid string, horizon or mapping. Each output stage needs at least one string.
